items.title: 6.11.4 System (reaction) ki entropy tabdeeli ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.4, printed page 138.

blocks.text: System ki entropy tabdeeli delta S(system) = sum S(products) - sum S(reactants) hai. 2Ca(s) + O2(g) se 2CaO(s) ke liye, standard entropies Ca(s) 41.40, O2(g) 205.0 aur CaO(s) 39.70 J fi K fi mol ke saath: delta S = 2 x 39.70 - (2 x 41.40 + 205.0) = 79.40 - 287.8 = -208.4 J fi K fi mol. Manfi qeemat dikhati hai ke system ki entropy ghati hai; phir bhi calcium oxygen se khud-ba-khud react karta hai, to mahol ki entropy ka bhi hissa hona chahiye, kyunke reaction ke mumkin hone ke liye kul entropy tabdeeli musbat honi chahiye.

blocks.caption: 2Ca + O2 se 2CaO ke liye entropy tabdeeli
header: Standard entropies, J fi K fi mol

blocks.prompt: N2(g) + 3H2(g) se 2NH3(g) ke liye S qeematon 191.5, 130.6 aur 193 J fi K fi mol se delta S nikalein, aur batayein ke nishan ka kya matlab hai.
blocks.explanation: Delta S = 2 x 193 - (191.5 + 3 x 130.6) = 386 - 583.3 = -197.3 J fi K fi mol. Gas ke chaar moles do banne par system zyada ba-tarteeb hota hai; reaction 25 degrees C par phir bhi mumkin hai kyunke us ki kharij hararat mahol ki entropy us se zyada barhati hai.

items: Delta S(system) = sum S(products) - sum S(reactants); 2Ca + O2 se 2CaO: 79.40 - 287.8 = -208.4 J fi K fi mol, manfi, phir bhi khud-ba-khud kyunke mahol ki entropy barhti hai; kul musbat honi chahiye.
